nodes.name: Count Sent Today
nodes.notes: The daily cap is enforced against what was actually sent, not what was queued.

nodes.name: Apply Daily Caps + Pacing
nodes.notes: Caps come from the campaign, falling back to config/followups.default.json. Overflow is held for the next window, never dropped.

nodes.name: Sending Mode
nodes.notes: manual is the default and the only compliant path for a first-touch DM.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.released_total + " approved message(s) ready to send", items: $input.all().map(i => i.json) }) }}

nodes.name: Notify Operator
nodes.notes: Optional: Slack/email/anything. Leave OPERATOR_WEBHOOK_URL unset to skip - the console polls the send queue anyway.

nodes.name: Send Via Instagram Graph API
nodes.notes: Only valid INSIDE an open conversation window - i.e. for replies to someone who messaged first. A first-touch DM has no recipient_igsid and is routed to the manual path instead.

nodes.name: Conversation Already Open?
nodes.notes: Without an open conversation the API cannot deliver a cold DM. The item falls back to a human.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_outreach_id: $json.outreach_id, p_sent_by: "n8n:wf08", p_send_mode: "graph_api", p_external_message_id: $json.message_id ?? null }) }}
